title: Rental of accessory berths to non-residents

blocks.html: Berths or moorings for non-commercial pleasure boats provided as an accessory use to a residential use may be rented to persons who are not occupants of the residences to which such berths or moorings are accessory, for the accommodation of the non-commercial pleasure boats used by such non-residents, provided that:
blocks.plainText: Berths or moorings for non-commercial pleasure boats provided as an accessory use to a residential use may be rented to persons who are not occupants of the residences to which such berths or moorings are accessory, for the accommodation of the non-commercial pleasure boats used by such non-residents, provided that:

blocks.html: (a)        not more than 40 percent of such berths or moorings are so occupied by non-residents;
blocks.plainText: (a) not more than 40 percent of such berths or moorings are so occupied by non-residents;

blocks.html: (b)        except in Manhattan Community Boards 1 through 8, an additional off-street parking space, in a location adjacent to the docking facility, or off-site in accordance with the provisions of Section 62-412 (Accessory residential off-site parking), is provided for each berth or mooring so occupied;
blocks.plainText: (b) except in Manhattan Community Boards 1 through 8, an additional off-street parking space, in a location adjacent to the docking facility, or off-site in accordance with the provisions of Section 62-412 (Accessory residential off-site parking), is provided for each berth or mooring so occupied;

blocks.html: (c)        such off-street parking spaces comply with all other provisions of this Resolution for the district in which they are located; and
blocks.plainText: (c) such off-street parking spaces comply with all other provisions of this Resolution for the district in which they are located; and

blocks.html: (d)        the total number of accessory berths or moorings does not exceed the total number of dwelling units to which they are accessory.
blocks.plainText: (d) the total number of accessory berths or moorings does not exceed the total number of dwelling units to which they are accessory.
